config.synthetic_data_disclaimer: SYNTHETIC DEMONSTRATION — NOT REAL DREAMT RESULTS
config.synthetic_generation_method: deterministic synthetic demonstration fixture; not real DREAMT data

feature_accel_magnitude_mean.definition: Mean vector magnitude of the 3-axis accelerometer signal.

feature_accel_magnitude_std.definition: Std. dev. of vector-magnitude samples over the epoch.

feature_accel_valid_count.definition: Count of valid accelerometer samples used in the epoch summary.

feature_accel_x_mean.definition: Mean acceleration along the x-axis in the epoch.

feature_accel_x_std.definition: Std. dev. of x-axis acceleration samples in the epoch.

feature_accel_y_mean.definition: Mean acceleration along the y-axis in the epoch.

feature_accel_y_std.definition: Std. dev. of y-axis acceleration samples in the epoch.

feature_accel_z_mean.definition: Mean acceleration along the z-axis in the epoch.

feature_accel_z_std.definition: Std. dev. of z-axis acceleration samples in the epoch.

feature_eda_max.definition: Maximum electrodermal activity over the epoch.

feature_eda_mean.definition: Mean electrodermal activity over the epoch.

feature_eda_min.definition: Minimum electrodermal activity over the epoch.

feature_eda_phasic_mean.definition: Mean positive deviation from tonic EDA over the epoch.

feature_eda_std.definition: Std. dev. of electrodermal activity over the epoch.

feature_eda_tonic_mean.definition: Median EDA value used as a tonic baseline estimate.

feature_eda_valid_count.definition: Valid EDA samples used in the epoch-level summary.

feature_hr_max.definition: Maximum heart rate in beats per minute over the epoch.

feature_hr_mean.definition: Average heart rate in beats per minute over the epoch.

feature_hr_median.definition: Median heart rate in beats per minute over the epoch.

feature_hr_min.definition: Minimum heart rate in beats per minute over the epoch.

feature_hr_std.definition: Population standard deviation of heart rate samples in the epoch.

feature_hr_valid_count.definition: Valid HR samples used in the epoch-level summary.

feature_hrv_available.definition: Whether RR/IBI-derived HRV is available for the epoch.

feature_hrv_rmssd.definition: Root-mean-square of successive RR differences in milliseconds.

feature_hrv_sdnn.definition: Standard deviation of RR intervals in milliseconds.

feature_movement_intensity.definition: Mean vector magnitude used as a motion-intensity summary.

modality_available_accel_x.definition: Whether x-axis accelerometer data were available in the epoch.

modality_available_accel_y.definition: Whether y-axis accelerometer data were available in the epoch.

modality_available_accel_z.definition: Whether z-axis accelerometer data were available in the epoch.

modality_available_eda.definition: Whether EDA data were available in the epoch.

modality_available_hr.definition: Whether the HR modality was available in the epoch.

modality_available_ibi.definition: Whether IBI/RR inputs were available in the epoch.

preprocessing_version.definition: Version tag for the synthetic preprocessing logic.
